title: Our approach to data and AI
summary: Just over a year after launching ChatGPT, AI is changing how we live, work and learn. It’s also raised important conversations about data in the age of AI. More on our approach, a new Media Manager for creators and content owners, and where we’re headed.
body: Just over a year after launching ChatGPT, AI is changing how we live, work and learn. It’s also raised important conversations about data in the age of AI. More on our approach, a new Media Manager for creators and content owners, and where we’re headed.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于数据与AI的最新战略声明，强调了在AI时代处理数据的重要性。公司宣布将推出“Media Manager”工具，旨在为内容创作者和版权所有者提供更精细的控制权，使其能够管理其内容在AI模型训练中的使用方式。此举是OpenAI在应对版权争议、提升数据透明度及加强与内容生态合作方面的重要举措，反映了行业在平衡模型训练需求与创作者权益方面的最新探索。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI发布了关于数据处理与AI治理的最新战略，并宣布推出Media Manager工具以保障内容创作者权益。
